title: Historical gp_01 component checked against current ledger/source/config

scope.historical_snapshot_label: pre-landing 38-row inventory; frozen when ledger had 205 records, per primary instruction; primary later reports commit cbe72882 landed the three in-progress rows (live ledger 202/35), not refreshed here
scope.distinction: The 20-row gp_01 is the frozen historical 38-row snapshot component. It remains a 20-row subset of the current 32 GP rows; this inventory does not relabel the historical snapshot as current32.

historical_topology.warning: Shared-symbol connectivity establishes reachability in the frozen source-use inventory, not a retail translation-unit boundary or shared semantic type.

source_map_and_assertion_evidence.recovered_source_map_scope: docs/EVIDENCE.md §2 maps TOWN scene overlay objects by assertion source lines (plus MAIN card/debug sources described in §1). It contains no assertion-based source-map assignment for these SLUS rows.
source_map_and_assertion_evidence.gp_inventory_source_paths: docs/evidence/fidelity_gp_rows.tsv has a per-row source path for all 20 and source_exists=True at its capture. Current src/slus/<basename>.c files were stat/read directly. This is the matching-source inventory, not recovered retail source ownership proof.
source_map_and_assertion_evidence.no_component_assert_evidence: ledger/evidence/rows.jsonl has zero assert_sites/assert_copies for every present component record; ten IDs have no evidence-index row because tools/evidence.py omits empty records.
source_map_and_assertion_evidence.current_config_module_coverage: config/slus_modules.json has no member row or data symbol for these component rows/symbols. This is an absence in the current module manifest, not a prohibition on evidence-backed present ownership.
source_map_and_assertion_evidence.split_path_ambiguity: ledger/splits/slus.jsonl records logical src/<basename>.c paths while the GP row source inventory and on-disk C files use src/slus/<basename>.c; joined here by the slus/<basename> row ID.

source_function_count_notes.row_registry: ledger/rows.jsonl `defs` counts are recorded per registered row; these symbol lists can include aliases/include-derived entries and overlap adjacent row mappings, so do not equate them with top-level source bodies or sum them into a TU count.
source_function_count_notes.method: Source bytes are filesystem stat; lines use splitlines. Lexical lower bounds count recognizable top-level function-body openings in the exact source file. No source rebuild was performed and no definitive source function total is claimed.

evidence_coverage.docs_index: docs/EVIDENCE.md §1 identifies recovered assertion sites as source-file/line evidence and §2 gives the TOWN overlay map. Its source map is specific to those TOWN/MAIN assertion sources, not this SLUS component.
evidence_coverage.generator: tools/evidence.py build() joins assertion sites, developer identifiers, randomizer map, resident VM table, prior knowledge, applied names, and script call-table names. It emits only rows with at least one evidence field.
evidence_coverage.ledger_rows_path: ledger/evidence/rows.jsonl; filtered to these exact 20 IDs.

assertion_source_evidence.statement: No recovered assertion source file/line or developer-identifier source evidence is indexed for these 20 rows. A missing index row means no evidence from the indexed sources, not that no possible evidence exists elsewhere.
